target: AArch64 QEMU/HVF using UTM-bundled QEMU, one guest CPU, PCI graphical terminal
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-demo-compiledemo-current.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-demo-compiledemo
verified: CompileDemo launched through the graphical terminal and its generated JIT expressions ran.
The probe observed the expected printed results, including 9 from the final loop.
Escape returned to a responsive graphical terminal; 40+2 returned 42 and zstatus reported failed=0.
scope_note: Automated runtime acceptance on this exact ISO. It refreshes CompileDemo evidence but does not increase the historical count of distinct runtime-accepted Demo sources. Live UTM interaction and Pi behavior are separate checks.
